source_context: Sandbox historical replay evidence pilot for Singapore chemicals manufacturing movements.
evidence_items: Singapore chemicals output in 2021 was influenced by stronger petrochemical demand and recovery in regional industrial activity.
Higher chemical production reflected improved demand for basic chemicals and specialty chemicals as global manufacturing recovered.
Petrochemical production benefited from recovering downstream demand, although feedstock prices and naphtha prices remained important constraints.
Chemical plant operations and petrochemical plant utilisation affected output patterns during the year.
